spacing.sectionRhythm: Use 24-48px vertical rhythm; compact UI groups may use 12-20px.

componentRules: One component class should have one visual hierarchy across screens.
Persistent navigation must reserve content space.
Long RU/EN/VI content must wrap intentionally.
Service cards use unique group imagery and consistent aspect treatment.
Critical CTA cannot be visually covered by sticky/fixed UI.
Text cannot be placed outside its container bounds or float over decorative shapes without an explicit overlay component.
